owner_calls.question: Should Infinata stay 'At large' after episode 49, or become 'Deceased'?
options: Keep At large (Wikipedia says only that Spider-Man closes his eyes and leaves the Fifth Dimension)
Change to Deceased (Marvel Database says revealing the secret kills Infinata)
owner_calls.evidence: The Wikipedia episode list for 'Revolt in the Fifth Dimension' (episode 49) ends with Spider-Man learning that fear is Infinata's only power, closing his eyes and leaving the Fifth Dimension. It says nothing about Infinata's fate. The Marvel Database page for Infinata (Earth-6799) says 'The secret being put out killed Infinata.' The two sources don't agree, so under the rules this record passes, but it needs your decision.
